root_idea.summary: A root oriented toward joining or linking one thing to another.
root_idea.development: From the idea of connection, الوصية develops as speech linked to an action that another is to carry out, including an injunction, a testamentary disposition, and mutual exhortation.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The isolated QAC Form I analysis has no separate lexical entry in the supplied evidence; its identical surface and inheritance-context usage are covered under the lexically supported citation form أَوْصَى.

senses.definition: To enjoin, charge, instruct, or command someone to do something.
senses.usage_conditions: Typically takes the person addressed as an object and the prescribed action or content as its complement; the charge may carry an admonitory or exhortative force.

senses.definition: To enjoin, instruct, or charge someone with a prescribed action.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for an authoritative instruction or charge, including an instruction given to a person or community and one presented as divinely prescribed.

senses.definition: To make a will or bequeath property to someone.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in testamentary and inheritance contexts; passive wording can present a bequest as something made or stipulated.

senses.definition: To enjoin, charge, or urge one another.
senses.usage_conditions: A reciprocal construction in which members of a group mutually pass on a charge or exhortation.

senses.definition: One who makes a will or appoints a testamentary disposition; a testator.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrence is used in a testamentary context.

senses.definition: The act of enjoining, charging, or instructing.
senses.usage_conditions: The verbal noun denotes the issuing of a charge to another person or group.

senses.definition: The making of a will or testamentary bequest.
senses.usage_conditions: In its Quranic occurrence, the verbal noun is used in a testamentary context.

senses.definition: An injunction, prescribed charge, or admonitory command.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for a formal instruction or ordinance, including a charge presented as binding or divinely prescribed.

senses.definition: A will, testament, or testamentary bequest.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for a disposition of property or other instructions intended to take effect in a testamentary context.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A commissioned agent; especially an executor appointed by a will.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal designation for the person entrusted with carrying out another person's instructions or testamentary appointment.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The Form II injunction and its verbal-noun branch are represented.
The bequest and testator branches are represented.
The reciprocal enjoining construction is represented.
The commissioned-agent and executor noun is represented under Classical meanings.
The injunction or admonitory-charge branch is represented.

cautions: The single QAC group qac-form:wSy:yuwSiy:verb:I is publicly merged into أَوْصَى because the supplied lexical evidence does not establish a separate Form I citation form, while its occurrence is covered by the same lexically supported bequest construction.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: Mufradat row 1586 contains the isolated wording «وَوَصَّى: أَنْشَأَ فَضْلَهُ»; its syntax and lexical force are unclear in the supplied text, and no independently located Quran usage is attached, so it is not promoted to a separate sense.
